tei:div.tei:p: khri skor mchog gyur zha lu ba'i byung tshul dang*/ myang yul chags lugs bzhugs so/

oṃ swa ti/ 'gro ba'i bla ma dpal ldan sa skya ba/ /'jam dbyangs rnam 'phrul rim pa'i sku drin las/ /dbus gtsang 'di yang khri stong dbang sgyur ba'i/ /sde dpon stobs ldan che gnyan mang byung ba/ /de'i nang nas rigs bzang sku nye shing*/ khri skor bcu bsum dag gi mchog gyur pa/ /zha lu sku zhang byon tshul 'di ltar grags | de'ang 'di ltar thos te/ sngon rgyal po khri lde 'od srung dang*/ btsun mo lcog ro zwa dkar rgyal lo legs la/ sras mnga' bdag dpal 'khor btsan/de'i btsun mo tshe yong za dkar rgyal la/ sras skyid sde nyi ma mgon dang*/ bal za phan rgyal la/ khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal btsan chung btsan 'dis/ sngon ma stod phyogs su byon/ gu ge spu hrengs ya tshe rnams kyi/ mnga' bdag mdzad pa la sras dpal gyi mgon dang*/ bkra shis nyi ma mgon/ lde btsun mgon rnams byung ba la/ stod kyi mgon gsum zer ro/ /de'i rgyud stod kyi rgyal rgyud rnams yin no/ /gcung po khri bkra shis brtsegs pa dpal/ /rt-ing la stod phyogs su 'phyugs | mnga' ris gung thang man la chags/ sras dpal ldai dang 'od ldai/ skyid ldai rnams byung ba la/ smad kyi lde gsum zer/ gcung skyid lde de/ 'jad rta nag ngos su phog pa la/ sras drug byung ba'i lnga pa'i rgyud 'gro rtsod dang*/ mus mdzad la sogs byang phyogs la yod/ sras gcig gtsang 'grom pa dang*/ shab sran | myang stod smad du byon pas/ nyang yul du sras gsum pa'i che ba/ khyung rtsad/ bar pa bre rtsad/ chung pa la lce 'tshed klartsadabluzer/ khong mched gsum gyi myang stod smad la yul bgos/ sa ris byas pa ni/ phu ha ho gang bzang nas/'da' bcug pa yu ba gdong yan la/ bod 'brog cha snyoms pa'i yul sde chen po gsum du phye te/ phu byang shar ri nang spangs 'khar la gtad/ mda' lho nub gangs ye sham bu la gtad pa/ bseg 'gros su yod pa la/ yul sde chen po gcig du byas te/

gcen khyung rtsad kyi sa mtsham gtsang khang brag kha yan yin/'dis sa khong na phu na/ 'brog sde chen po gsum yod pa ni/ gam ru rgyang ru nying ru gsum/ bar na tshong dus chen po gcig yong pa ni/ sal ma tshong 'dus bya ba yod te/ phyis bkag nas gnas snying du 'phos pa'o/ /sa khong de rnams na mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa ni/ brag shos rnams shes rab che dge ba la brtson pa kho na yod do/ /phal shos rnams sdig shas che/ nya dang ri dgas rngon pa'o | | zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum yod pa ni/ zha mo snam phrug phad 'phyar yang yod | de skor phu'i 'brog sde ches/ 'da' zhing sa khyon chung pas cha ma snyaums pas/ sha se khog tu nyo tshong byed par byung ngo*/ /bar pa ldai rtsad kyi dbang rigs/ gtsang gad brag kha man/ sna bo brag rdog yan la/ yul sdai chen po gcig tu byed pa'i | de'ang phu swa ma sā'u/ byang shar dang*/ mda' gab bya dkar/ lho nub la bstan pa/ bsegs 'gros su yod pa/ phu'i 'brog sde gsum ni/ rgyang 'khar/ skyid mkhar/ mag ngag rnams so/ /bar gyi tshong dus gcig ni/ 'od gsum ti du dgu'i tshong dus bya'o/ /mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis ni/ drag shos rnams shin du phyug zhan pa rnams dbul zhing 'phongs/ zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum ni/ rnga ma phyings pa/ ble phra yod do/ /phu'i 'brog sde dang*/ mda'i zhing pa rnams cha 'amanyomasaklasnyomasablupas/ sha phyed tshong byed pa byung ngo*/ /chung pa lce rtsad gyi dbang rigs | sna bo brag rdog man bcug pa yu ba gdong yan la/ yul sdai chen po gcig tu byed/ de'ang phu byang shar 'khor stod la kha dang*/ 'da' lho nub chu rgo gzhung la bstan pa/ bsegs 'graus su yod pa/ de'i phu na 'brog sde gsum ni/ sgrol lcags ra gsum mo/ bar gyi tshong dus ni/ gtsang tshong dus gur mo'o/ /mi rigs mi 'dra ba gnyis ni/ drag shos rnams mdzangs shas che/ zhen shos rnams khram shas che'o/ /zong sna mi 'dra ba gsum ni/

gtsang ther/ dor skyegs/ star zon rnams yod do/ /phu'i 'brog sde chung/ 'da'i zhing sa khyon ches cha ma snyoms pas | sha gzugs tshong byed pa 'byung ngo*/ /de ltar yul bgos byas pas/ gzhan gang dang gang cha snyoms par byung na'ang*/ gam ru'i g.yam pa legs po de la gang yang yong*/ mi mdzad pa'i gter dang 'dra bas/ phyugs pa dang g.yam pas rgyal lo/ /zer byung cing*/ da lta khyung g.yam du grags so/ /dus phyi rting rtsad po mched gsum la/ dar gud byung te/ yul sde gsum ka gcung po lce rtsad kyi bzung | de gong nyang stod gzhung phal che ba zhing la thag ma dang*/ chu mig la bstan pa las med pa la/ lce rtsed/ shes rab dang 'byor stobs che bas sa rgya 'di la bde chod pa'i thabs dgos pa 'dug zer nas/ myang stod kyi byang rgyud du/ rtsa rnams kyi rgyal rkas dang*/ lho rgyud du spangs yul bzhengs kyi 'od rka bya ba dang*/ nyang smad byang du pa tshas rka mo che dang*/ lho rgyud 'aspes rnamaklapa rnam blurka mo che rnams bzos/ rka bo che re re'i 'og na son khal khri khrag re re yod par byed cing*/ rka chen rnams ma 'jags bar la bsrung mi sdod pa'i mkhar gnyis bzhengs pa ni/ stod du rgyal grogs rtsai mkhar dang*/ smad du 'aspas rnam klapa rnamablurtse mkhar gnyis/ lce rtsad kyi bzhengs pas na lce mkhar du chags pa yin la/ de lta bu'i rka chen bzhi dang mkhar gnyis ni/ da lta'i bar du yod cing*/ sa 'dul la bed spyod shin tu che bar byung bas/ lce rtsad kyi byas pa lag rjes shin tu che bar gda' cing*/ zha lu ba'i dpon rgyud 'dis rtsa ba lce rtsad kyi rgyud pa yin pas | de nas gdung rabs mang rabs 'ong pas/ bod du bstan pa phyi dar gyis thog ma/ dbus gtsang gi mi bcu pos mdo smad nas chos zhus pas/ lo ston rdo rje dbang phyug gi nyang smad rgyan gong gi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ de'i dngos slob/ mgo dmag g.yu 'khrungs gi bu chen/

lce btsun sher 'byung gi zha lu wa mo'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ chos sde btab rgya gar du byon/ sdom pa bskyar nas blangs/ zab chos mang du zhus so/ /der rt-ing zha lu ba mnga' thang 'byor stobs je che la song tshul ni/ khri skor gzhan rnams las lhag pa'i/ che khyad rnam pa lnga bya ba yod de/ de yang*/ gdung rus rtsad po yin pas che/ las kha bka' bzhi'i byas pas che/ dam chos rgya gar ma yin pas che/ de rnams ni gong du smaus pa ltar gdung rgyud sku zhang yin pas che/ sbyin bdag rgyal po yin pas che/ bya ba ni thog mar sku zhang ye shes kun dga'i lcam mo/ ma cig mkha' 'gro 'bum/'gro mgon phyag ni khab tu byon pa nas bzung ste/ chos rje bla ma sku mched/ bla chen kun rgyal ba yab sras la sogs/ ding sang yan/ gdung rgyud khu dbon pas sku zhang na rim gyi bar la/ sku nye 'brel ba nas/ sde bdag gzhan rnams las ches lhag par/ sa skya ba dang 'brel che'o/ /'gro 'gon phyag na yab yum pa'i sras | bla ma dharma pha la rakṣi ta gong du byon/ hor o ja du rgyal po dang mjal dus/ bod dbus gtsang na nged kyi zhang po zha lu khri dpon bya ba yod pa la/ lung las kha bzang po gnang dgos zhus pas/ bla ma'i zhang po yin na nged kyi yang zhang po yin du chug la/ khri skor dpon po stong dpon byin pos phud du khur ba gyis shig mi rabs kyi bar la khri skor 'jags su chug gsungs pa'i lung gtsang ma gnang ba dang*/ gong ma yon mchod kyi sku rim la dmigs nas/ gser dngul las grub pa'i bstan gsum gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa bzhengs pa gyis gsung nas/ gser bre chen brgya dang*/ dngul bre chen lnga brgya'i mgo byas pa'i gnang sbyin bzang po bskur/ de'i cha rkyen gyis zha lu gser khang du grags pa'i lha khang dbu rtse che chung ngo mtshar can mang du thugs rje chen pos bzhengs/ tshong 'dus 'phrul pe bzhengs/ de'i rting sku zhang kun dga' don grub pa dang*/

sku zhang grags pa rin chen pas ring la/ rang byon 'phags pa spyan drangs/ zha lu gnas nang dang*/ ri phug yang dgon btab/ chos dpon la/ chos rje bu ston kha che gdan drangs/ de pa yab sras la sogs mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs tog bdag rkyen mdzad pas/ da lta'i bar du/ thub stan nyin mo ltar gsal ba 'di lags so/ /sku zhang byon tshul nyang yul chags tshul 'di klabris pasablusku chen gyis mchog bstan 'dzin 'ayod yod klayon mchodablurnams sku tshe ring zhing | 'gro kun rgyal ba'i sku gsum myur du thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig dge legs 'phel gyur cig/// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed/zha lu ba dang*/ myang yul gyi skor/ -PAGE 208--PAGE 207-
